LibreDWG (dwg2dxf.exe, libredwg-0.dll) - license and source notice
====================================================================

This folder contains a Windows build of LibreDWG, distributed under the
GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version.
The full license text is in the file COPYING in this folder.

  Program version reported by "dwg2dxf.exe --version": dwg2dxf 0.14
  Project home:  https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/
  Source code:   https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg
                 https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/libredwg/   (release tarballs)

The complete corresponding source code of this program is available from the
locations above. On request, the distributor of this system will also provide
the matching source code for the binary files in this folder.

The road-ledger application does not link against LibreDWG. It only starts
dwg2dxf.exe as a separate process (server/lib/dwgConvert.js) to convert uploaded
DWG drawings into DXF files.

Other DLLs in this folder (libiconv-2.dll, libpcre2-8-0.dll, libpcre2-16-0.dll)
are third-party runtime libraries required by dwg2dxf.exe and keep their own
licenses (libiconv: GNU LGPL; PCRE2: BSD).
